gaps.name: Joint feature kernels
gaps.finding: The strongest low-density SVM family received 22 single-block additions and no multiblock configurations. Earlier concatenation-based RBF models combine block distances multiplicatively in similarity space. Separate additive cosine/Tanimoto kernels and their pairs were not evaluated.
gaps.action: phase20 screens single auxiliary kernels, five feature pairs, and training-label-alignment weights.

gaps.name: Effective sample mass in class balancing
gaps.finding: Installed SVC._validate_targets computes balanced class weights from y without sample_weight. Downweighted pseudo-labels still count equally in automatic class-frequency estimates. Earlier trials covered raw joint counts and fixed gold/initial priors, but not effective weighted counts.
gaps.action: phase20 compares effective weighted class counts and repeated-vector weighting. This is a modeling alternative, not evidence that old evaluation scores are invalid.

gaps.name: Tri-training
gaps.finding: Previous static consensus, self-training, bagging and model averaging did not implement iterative three-classifier cross-teaching with agreement/error controls.
gaps.action: Still an untested candidate; no claim of a measured improvement.

gaps.name: Validation-matched selection
gaps.finding: Default grouped CV mixes early gold and deliberately rare-enriched later gold. It does not recreate the randomly sampled validation distribution or later Kaggle distribution. Some chronological stress tests and covariate weighting were tried, but no unbiased target-distribution risk estimate is available.
gaps.action: Do not infer the leader algorithm or our latest Kaggle score from separate validation scores.

gaps.name: Final refit on all supplied labels
gaps.finding: Current final predictions fit 157 training gold labels and keep all 78 validation labels out. A frozen train+validation final refit would use 235 labeled examples, about 50% more. The provided assignment does not explicitly discuss whether this final refit is permitted; it cannot be used to claim a held-out validation improvement.
gaps.action: Not performed. Keep current reported validation score separate from any eventual train+validation model. The latest candidate has no measured Kaggle score.

references.title: Cortes, Mohri, Rostamizadeh: Algorithms for Learning Kernels Based on Centered Alignment
